description: Header file defining the TurretComponent class, which manages turret behavior including targeting, aiming, and movement logic in a game.

classes.name: TurretComponent
classes.description: A component class for turret behavior, including targeting, aiming, and movement functionalities.

methods.name: TurretComponent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the turret component with an entity.

methods.name: HandlePrepareNetCode
methods.description: Handles network code preparation messages.

methods.name: GetAimAngles
methods.description: Returns the current aim angles of the turret.

methods.name: ~TurretComponent
methods.description: Destructor for the turret component.

methods.name: SetRange
methods.description: Sets the attack range of the turret.

methods.name: GetTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the current entity target.

methods.name: TargetValid
methods.description: Checks if the current target is valid.

methods.name: RemoveTarget
methods.description: Clears the current target.

methods.name: FindEntityTarget
methods.description: Finds a new entity target based on a comparison function.

methods.name: MoveHeadToTarget
methods.description: Moves the turret's head towards its target direction.

methods.name: TrackEntityTarget
methods.description: Updates the turret's aim towards its entity target.

methods.name: ResetDirection
methods.description: Resets the turret's target direction to its initial value.

methods.name: ResetPitch
methods.description: Resets the turret's pitch to horizon.

methods.name: LowerPitch
methods.description: Sets the pitch to the minimum reachable angle.

methods.name: TargetCanBeHit
methods.description: Checks if the current head position can hit the target.

methods.name: SetBaseDirection
methods.description: Determines the turret's base direction after construction or reset.

methods.name: TargetValid
methods.description: Validates if a target entity is suitable, considering if it's new.

methods.name: TorsoAngles
methods.description: Calculates the angles of the turret's torso.

methods.name: RelativeAnglesToAbsoluteAngles
methods.description: Converts relative angles to absolute angles.

methods.name: AbsoluteAnglesToRelativeAngles
methods.description: Converts absolute angles to relative angles.

methods.name: DirectionToAbsoluteAngles
methods.description: Converts a direction vector to absolute angles.

methods.name: DirectionToRelativeAngles
methods.description: Converts a direction vector to relative angles.

methods.name: AbsoluteAnglesToDirection
methods.description: Converts absolute angles to a direction vector.

methods.name: RelativeAnglesToDirection
methods.description: Converts relative angles to a direction vector.
